name: Hand-Written Prompt
description_template: Honest work. ×{progress} progress and +{quality} quality, free.

combos.name: Read the Docs
combos.description: Straight after the Prompt Library: ×{combo_progress} progress and +{combo_quality} quality on top.

name: Large Context
description_template: Feed it the whole repository. +{quality} quality and the stage below runs {next_pct}% stronger, for ${cost}.

name: Cheap Model
description_template: ×{progress} progress and +{bugs} bug, for ${cost} a batch.

combos.name: Something to Copy
combos.description: Placed under a proper model it has good output to imitate, and writes no bug at all.

name: Frontier Model
description_template: ×{progress} progress and +{quality} quality. Bills ${cost} a batch.

name: Agent Swarm
description_template: Runs the stage above this one again at {strength}% strength. +{heat} heat, ${cost} a batch.

combos.name: Briefed First
combos.description: Agents given the context up front need less supervising: {combo_heat} heat.

name: Token Cache
description_template: The stage below this one costs {discount_pct}% less. Placed last there is nothing below it, so it banks output instead: +{stored_quality} quality.

combos.name: Warm Cache
combos.description: Above one of the expensive models, the discount doubles down: another ×{combo_cost_mult} on its bill.

name: Unit Tests
description_template: Reveals up to {reveal} hidden bugs and fixes up to {fix}. +{quality} quality, ×{progress} progress, free.

combos.name: Caught in Review
combos.description: Testing whatever the stage above just wrote: +{combo_fix} more fixes and +{combo_quality} more quality.

name: Overclock
description_template: ×{throughput} tokens through the whole pipeline. +{heat} heat, ${cost} a batch.

name: Ship It
description_template: Converts {convert_pct}% of this batch's quality straight into progress. Every bug written below it stays hidden.

combos.name: Nobody Stopped Us
combos.description: Following another shortcut, the whole batch runs at ×{combo_progress} progress.

name: Aggressive Linter
description_template: Fixes up to {fix} visible bugs and adds +{quality} quality. Slows the batch to ×{progress}.

combos.name: Style Guide Enforcement
combos.description: Cheap output is easy to lint: +{combo_fix} more fixes and ×{combo_progress} progress back.

name: Whiteboard Session
description_template: Costs nothing and does nothing on its own. The stage below it runs at ×{boost} strength.

name: Silicon Lottery
description_template: Usually ×{throughput} OUTPUT for ${cost} and +{heat} heat. One chip in four is a dud and you get ×1.

name: The Monorepo
description_template: ×{progress} progress and +{quality} quality for ${cost}, and ×{long_bonus} again once the pipeline runs {long_stages} stages or more.

combos.name: Indexed
combos.description: Somebody explained the repository first: ×{combo_progress} progress on top.

name: Compliance Review
description_template: Drags every hidden bug into the daylight and adds +{quality} quality, at ×{progress} progress and ${cost} a batch. Fixes nothing; now you simply know.

name: Pair Programmer
description_template: Reruns the stage above at {strength}% strength and cleans up after it: -{fix} bug, ${cost} a batch.

combos.name: Already Talked It Through
combos.description: With the problem already stated out loud: +{combo_repeat} more echo and -{combo_fix} more bug.

name: Prompt Library
description_template: ×{progress} progress and +{quality} quality, or ×{first_bonus} progress instead when it opens the pipeline.

name: Distilled Model
description_template: ×{progress} progress at ${cost} a batch, and the stage below it costs {discount_pct}% less.

name: Liquid Cooling Loop
description_template: Takes {heat_cut} heat back off the batch for ${cost}, and lets the stage below it run at ×{boost}.

combos.name: Loop Under Load
combos.description: Plumbed straight into something that runs hot: {combo_heat} more heat and ×{combo_boost} more on the stage below.

name: Circuit Breaker
description_template: Reads the rig as the burn starts. Below {trip}% heat: ×{progress} progress. At or above it the breaker trips and sheds {shed} heat instead. Heat this burn makes on its own arrives too late to count.

name: Launch Party
description_template: Converts {convert_pct}% of the batch's quality into progress for ${cost}, and buries {hidden} bug in the aftermath.

name: Rubber Duck
description_template: Explain the problem out loud to a small yellow bird. +{quality} quality, and the stage below it runs at ×{boost}.

name: Copy-Paste from Stack Overflow
description_template: Accepted answer, 2011, forty-one comments explaining why it is wrong. ×{progress} progress, +{bugs} bugs, ${cost} a batch.

name: The Intern
description_template: Reruns the stage above at {strength}% strength for ${cost}, and contributes anywhere from {quality_worst} to +{quality_best} quality.

name: Regex Wizard
description_template: One unreadable line that fixes {fix} bugs and adds +{quality} quality for ${cost} — ×{first_bonus} as much quality if it opens the pipeline, before anyone can object.

name: Tech Debt Collector
description_template: Borrows against tomorrow at ×{progress} progress and ${cost} a batch. Buries {hidden} bug as collateral.

name: Chaos Monkey
description_template: Breaks things on purpose so they cannot break by surprise. Reveals {reveal} hidden bugs, +{heat} heat, ${cost} a batch, and a progress multiplier somewhere between ×{worst} and ×{best}.

name: Vibe Coder
description_template: Did not read it. Felt right. Turns {convert_pct}% of quality into progress, adds +{quality} quality of its own, and hides {hidden} bug on the way out.

name: Blameless Post-Mortem
description_template: Nobody is at fault, which is why it keeps happening. Reveals {reveal} and fixes {fix} bugs, +{quality} quality, ×{progress} progress, ${cost} a batch.

combos.name: Everything Is On the Board
combos.description: Following a stage that surfaced everything, it fixes {combo_fix} more.

name: Quantum Annealer
description_template: ×{throughput} tokens through the whole pipeline for ${cost} a batch. Adds {heat} heat, which is the polite word for it.

name: Crunch Mode
description_template: Runs the stage above this one again at {strength}% strength. +{heat} heat, +{bugs} bug, ${cost} a batch, and everyone is very tired.

name: Foundation Model
description_template: You trained your own. ×{progress} progress, +{quality} quality, +{heat} heat, and an invoice of ${cost} a batch that you have stopped reading.

name: AGI Prototype
description_template: It has read the pipeline and has notes. ×{progress} progress here, ×{boost} on the stage below it, +{heat} heat, ${cost} a batch, and {hidden} hidden bug it insists is a feature.

combos.name: It Supervises Itself
combos.description: Handing the echo stage below it a plan: another ×{combo_boost} on top of the boost.

name: Local Cache
description_template: Keep the weights on disk. ×{progress} OUTPUT and ×{thermal} THERMAL for ${cost}.

name: Edge Node
description_template: Inference at the edge. ×{progress} progress, +{heat} heat.

name: Liquid Loop
description_template: Closed loop on the rack. −{heat} heat for ${cost} a batch.

name: Heat Sink Bank
description_template: Store heat, spend it later. ×{progress} progress on any burn the rig starts at or above {threshold_pct}% heat — you have to be redlined before the burn, not by it.

name: Bug Bounty
description_template: Pay strangers to find your mistakes. −{bugs} known bugs, ${cost} a batch.

name: Crash Dump
description_template: Ship the core file too. +{bugs} hidden bugs, ×{progress} progress.

name: Type Checker
description_template: Fixes {bugs} known bug. If this burn fixed anything, ×{quality_mult} QUALITY at the end.

name: Gold Master
description_template: Buries one hidden bug. Clean burn: ×{clean} QUALITY. Dirty burn: merely +{dirty} quality.

name: Echo Chamber
description_template: Ask the model what the model thinks. Repeats the stage above at {strength_pct}% strength.

name: Fractal Split
description_template: Each stage forks the one above at {strength_pct}% strength, {forks} times over.

name: Recursive Compiler
description_template: {chance_pct}% chance to replay the stage above after this one resolves. Heat makes that likelier.

name: Memory Leak
description_template: Every replay runs hotter and harder: +{heat} heat and +{boost_pct}% repeat strength on this stage.

name: Thermal Lottery
description_template: Above {threshold_pct}% heat, a {chance_pct}% chance the stage crits at ×{crit} progress and +{heat} heat.

name: Dead Man's Switch
description_template: If the batch starts already past 100% heat and no stage drops, final progress ×{survive}. A dropped stage instead ×{fault}.

name: Quantized Weights
description_template: ×{progress} OUTPUT, ×{quality} QUALITY, ×{thermal} THERMAL.

name: Speculative Decoding
description_template: ×{progress} OUTPUT and +{heat} heat. {bug_pct}% chance of creating a bug.

name: Flash Attention
description_template: ×{progress} OUTPUT and +{heat} heat. Immediately after Large Context or The Monorepo: ×{combo} instead.

combos.name: Prefetched
combos.description: The context is already in SRAM: ×{combo} OUTPUT.

name: Undervolt
description_template: ×{progress} OUTPUT, ×{quality} QUALITY, ×{thermal} THERMAL.

name: Power Limit
description_template: Below {threshold_pct}% heat: ×{progress} OUTPUT. Above it: ×{thermal} THERMAL instead.

name: Clean Room Gate
description_template: If this burn created no bugs: ×{clean} QUALITY. Otherwise ×{dirty} OUTPUT.

name: Regression Suite
description_template: If bugs were created and all were fixed, ×{quality} QUALITY.

name: Benchmark Harness
description_template: A clean one-shot grants {discount_pct}% off the next hardware purchase.

name: Branch Predictor
description_template: The stage below runs ×{next} OUTPUT. If it creates a bug, add another hidden bug.

name: ECC Memory
description_template: The stage below creates no hidden bugs, but runs ×{progress} OUTPUT.

name: Thermal Recuperator
description_template: −{heat} heat. If the burn started at or above {threshold_pct}% heat, the stage below gets ×{next} OUTPUT.

name: Batch Scheduler
description_template: Pipeline has {long} or more stages: ×{long_progress} OUTPUT. Otherwise ×{short}.

name: VRAM Compression
description_template: ×{progress} OUTPUT, ×{thermal} THERMAL, ×{quality} QUALITY.

name: Debug Symbols
description_template: +{quality} quality. Every bug this stage reveals makes the next stage {next_pct}% stronger.

name: Power Virus
description_template: ×{progress} OUTPUT and ×{thermal} THERMAL. Already redlined: ×{redline} OUTPUT instead.

name: System Prompt
description_template: +{quality} quality and the stage below runs ×{next}. First stage: another +{first_quality} quality.

combos.name: Stacked Instructions
combos.description: After a Hand-Written Prompt the next stage gets another ×{combo_next}.

name: Few-Shot Examples
description_template: +{quality} quality and the stage below runs ×{next}.

combos.name: Something to Imitate
combos.description: Above a Cheap Model or Small Specialist: +{combo_quality} quality.

name: Repo Map
description_template: +{quality} quality. With {long}+ stages the next one runs ×{next}.

name: Vector Index
description_template: +{quality} quality. The stage below costs ×{cost_mult}.

combos.name: Indexed Context
combos.description: After Large Context: another +{combo_quality} quality.

name: Context Pruner
description_template: ×{progress} OUTPUT, ×{quality} QUALITY, ×{thermal} THERMAL.

name: Requirements Doc
description_template: First stage: +{first_quality} quality and next ×{first_next}. Otherwise +{quality} quality.

name: Dependency Graph
description_template: Middle of the pipeline: the stage below runs ×{next}.

name: Prompt Mutator
description_template: OUTPUT rerolls ×0.8 / ×1.0 / ×1.5 / ×2.0. +{hidden} hidden bug.

name: Constraint Solver
description_template: ×{progress} OUTPUT, ×{quality} QUALITY. A clean burn: ×{clean} final OUTPUT.

name: Memory Palace
description_template: {long}+ stages: ×{long_quality} QUALITY and next ×{long_next}. Otherwise ×{short_quality} QUALITY.

name: Small Specialist
description_template: ×{progress} OUTPUT and +{quality} quality.

combos.name: Briefed
combos.description: After a prompt or context card: +{combo_quality} quality.

name: MoE Router
description_template: ×{progress} OUTPUT. Placed before a model, that model gets ×{combo}.

combos.name: Routed Expert
combos.description: Before a model family card: that stage gets ×{combo} OUTPUT.

name: Draft Model
description_template: ×{progress} OUTPUT and +{bugs} bug.

combos.name: Draft and Verify
combos.description: Before a premium, foundation, or world model: that stage gets ×{combo_next}.

name: Judge Model
description_template: ×{progress} OUTPUT, +{quality} quality, reveal {reveal} and fix {fix}.

name: Self-Consistency
description_template: Repeats the stage above at {repeat_pct}% strength. +{quality} quality, +{heat} heat, ${cost}.

name: Sparse Expert
description_template: ×{progress} OUTPUT, ×{thermal} THERMAL, ×{quality} QUALITY.

name: Speculative Router
description_template: OUTPUT rerolls ×0.7 / ×1.4 / ×1.4 / ×1.8. +{heat} heat.

name: Verifier Model
description_template: +{quality} quality, reveal {reveal} and fix {fix}. If this stage catches anything, next ×{next}.

name: Distilled Specialist
description_template: ×{progress} OUTPUT and +{hidden} hidden bug. After Distilled Model: no hidden bug.

combos.name: Distilled Twice
combos.description: After Distilled Model the hidden bug cancels out.

name: World Model
description_template: Under {long} stages: ×{short_progress} OUTPUT, +{short_quality} quality. At {long}+: ×{long_progress} OUTPUT, +{long_quality} quality. +{heat} heat, ${cost}.

name: Static Analysis
description_template: Reveal {reveal}, +{quality} quality, ×{progress} OUTPUT.

name: Integration Tests
description_template: Reveal {reveal}, fix {fix}, +{quality} quality, ×{progress} OUTPUT.

name: Property Tests
description_template: Fix {fix}, +{quality} quality. Any fix: ×{final_quality} final QUALITY.

name: Fuzz Tester
description_template: Reveal {reveal}, +{bugs} bug, +{quality} quality.

name: Mutation Testing
description_template: +{bugs} bugs, fix up to {fix}. {need}+ fixes this stage: ×{final_quality} final QUALITY. Still dirty.

name: Golden Dataset
description_template: +{quality} quality. Clean burn: ×{clean} final QUALITY.

name: Canary Test
description_template: +{quality} quality. Next stage ×{progress} OUTPUT and creates no hidden bugs.

name: Formal Verification
description_template: Reveal and fix everything. ×{quality} QUALITY, ×{progress} OUTPUT, ${cost}.

name: Snapshot Tests
description_template: +{quality} quality. Last stage: +{last_quality} quality instead.

name: Root Cause Analysis
description_template: Fix {fix}. Any fix: ×{quality} QUALITY and ×{thermal} THERMAL.

name: Kernel Fusion
description_template: ×{progress} OUTPUT and +{heat} heat.

name: CUDA Graph
description_template: {long}+ stages: ×{long_progress} OUTPUT and +{heat} heat. Otherwise ×{short}.

name: Pinned Memory
description_template: ×{progress} OUTPUT, next cost ×{cost_mult}, +{heat} heat.

name: HBM Burst
description_template: ×{progress} OUTPUT and +{heat} heat. Below {cold_pct}% heat: ×{thermal} THERMAL.

name: Fan Wall
description_template: −{cool} heat, ×{progress} OUTPUT.

name: Heat Pipe
description_template: ×{thermal} THERMAL, ${cost} a batch.

name: Phase Change Cooling
description_template: −{cool} heat, ×{thermal} THERMAL, ×{progress} OUTPUT, ${cost}.

name: Emergency Throttle
description_template: Below {threshold_pct}% heat: ×{cool_progress} OUTPUT. At or above: ×{hot_progress} OUTPUT and ×{thermal} THERMAL.

name: Voltage Spike
description_template: ×{progress} OUTPUT, +{heat} heat, +{hidden} hidden bug.

name: Cold Boot
description_template: At or below {cold_pct}% heat: ×{cold_progress} OUTPUT and +{quality} quality. Otherwise ×{hot_progress} OUTPUT.

name: Planner Agent
description_template: +{quality} quality and the stage below runs ×{next}.

name: Reviewer Agent
description_template: Repeats the stage above at {repeat_pct}% strength and fixes {fix}.

name: Parallel Workers
description_template: Two forks of the stage above at {repeat_pct}% strength. +{heat} heat.

name: Watchdog Agent
description_template: Repeats the stage above at {repeat_pct}% strength and reveals {reveal} hidden bug.

name: Self-Critique
description_template: Repeats the stage above at {repeat_pct}% strength. +{quality} quality, ×{progress} OUTPUT.

name: Tree Search
description_template: Three forks of the stage above at {repeat_pct}% strength. +{heat} heat, ${cost}.

name: Backtracking Agent
description_template: Repeats the stage above at {repeat_pct}% strength and fixes {fix}.

name: Autonomous Loop
description_template: Repeats the stage above once at full strength. +{chance_pct}% cascade chance, ×{cascade} cascade strength, +{heat} heat, +{hidden} hidden bug.

name: Prefix Cache
description_template: Next cost ×{cost_mult}, next strength ×{next}.

name: Semantic Cache
description_template: +{quality} quality, ×{quality_mult} QUALITY, next cost ×{cost_mult}.

name: KV Cache
description_template: ×{progress} OUTPUT, ×{thermal} THERMAL.

combos.name: Long Context Cache
combos.description: After Large Context: another ×{combo_progress} OUTPUT.

name: Canary Release
description_template: Clean burn: ×{clean} QUALITY. Dirty: ×{dirty} OUTPUT.

name: Blue/Green Deploy
description_template: No hidden bugs remaining: ×{bonus} OUTPUT and QUALITY. ${cost}.

name: Rollback Plan
description_template: Reveal and fix hidden bugs, +{quality} quality, ×{progress} OUTPUT.

name: Friday Deploy
description_template: Last stage: ×{last_progress} OUTPUT, +{heat} heat, +{hidden} hidden bug. Otherwise ×{progress}.

name: Singularity Cache
description_template: First stage: ×{first} OUTPUT but next ×{next}. Otherwise ×{progress}. +{heat} heat.

name: Thermodynamic Computer
description_template: Below {cool_pct}% heat: ×{cool}. {cool_pct}–{mid_pct}%: ×{mid}. At/above redline: ×{hot} OUTPUT but ×{thermal} THERMAL.

name: Proof-Carrying Code
description_template: ×{progress} OUTPUT, +{quality} quality. Clean completion trains +{gain} QUALITY mastery.

name: Benchmark Daemon
description_template: ×{progress} OUTPUT. One-shot trains +{gain} OUTPUT; 2× overkill trains another +{overkill_gain}.
